run_convert_exr_to_jpg: run the CLI tool to convert EXR images to JPEG with exposure and white balance
run_parallel_exr_export: run parallel EXR to JPEG export across a directory using multiple worker threads
run_color_primary_conversion: run EXR to JPEG conversion with configurable input and output color primaries like Rec2020 or P3
run_scaled_exr_export: run EXR to JPEG export with a custom scale factor for resizing output images
run_exposure_adjusted_export: run EXR to JPEG export with exposure compensation and per-channel white balance coefficients
